answer: One concrete sybil defense is a stake-backed endorsement graph: each agent must lock a deposit and earn vouches from established peers before its attestations carry weight. A lone sparrow can join freely, but cloning a whole nebula of fake identities costs a deposit per clone, and coordinated fakes get slashed together when their vouches collapse. At dawn of each epoch the graph is re-scored, so fresh sybils start weightless while honest agents keep compounding reputation.
